questions.question: An unofficial grey market premium of ₹23 a share is being quoted. How much should you rely on it?

choices.text: Completely: it tells you the listing price.
A little at most: it is unregulated and easy to push around.
It is set by the stock exchange.

questions.explanation: The grey market premium of ₹23 for Watrana Rentals Limited is gossip with a number on it: nobody regulates it, and it often turns out wrong.

note: Only a few questions could be written: most of the figures they need haven't been read from the RHP yet.
